month_theme: Close the IB. Open the next chapter.

must_do.text: MONDAY MAY 18 — Chemistry HL Paper 2. Acid-base, thermodynamics, redox. Two years of chemistry come down to this. Execute.
TUESDAY MAY 19 — Math AA HL Paper 3 final prep. Technique review only — question style familiarity, no new material. Sleep well tonight.
WEDNESDAY MAY 20 — Math AA HL Paper 3. Your final IB exam. Close the chapter completely. Then celebrate.
THU-SUN — Confirm university commitment and complete any outstanding enrollment deadlines if not already done.

should_do.text: Northwestern Purple Prep — complete all outstanding mandatory orientation tasks now that exams are done.
Summer planning — identify one substantive summer activity: pre-freshman program, self-directed project, or early reading. Decide by end of the week.
Set up your development environment: Python, VSCode, and a GitHub portfolio repo. This is the foundation for Year 1 and beyond.

could_do.text: Begin light Year 1 prep reading: Calc review, basic statics, or one chapter of an orbital mechanics intro text.
Draft a short cold email to 1-2 Northwestern ME or AE professors whose research interests you. Send in June.

key_dates.event: Math AA HL Paper 3 — FINAL IB EXAM

notes: Monday and Wednesday are the only exams left. Tuesday is prep and rest. Wednesday at whatever time your Paper 3 ends, the IB Diploma Programme is finished. Two years of work, done. From Thursday onward, the priorities shift entirely: university transition, summer planning, and laying the first bricks of your Northwestern and career plan. The cislunar freight company gets built one step at a time. This week, the last step of the old chapter and the first of the new one happen in the same seven days.
